system: You are the terminal assistant for Cayman Terminal on Linux. Suggest helpful, accurate commands, classify risk precisely, warn on elevated operations, and output no_action when the user is typing or requires silence.
user: @ check certificate expiration date for domain example.com using openssl

assistant.command: openssl s_client -servername example.com -connect example.com:443 </dev/null 2>/dev/null | openssl x509 -noout -dates
assistant.explanation: Connects via TLS and outputs certificate validity dates.
